_about: Clinical threshold table for the Threshold-Based Anomaly Detection Engine (T10). Adult values. Each rule is inclusive unless it says min_exclusive or max_exclusive. A value matching no rule is 'borderline': no guideline defines a borderline band, so borderline is the gap between published normal and critical limits (state this in Section 3.2). Set 'verified' to true once the number has been checked against the primary source.

dbp.label: Diastolic blood pressure
dbp._note: No published low-diastolic cut-off was found, so low diastolic values are not scored.
